Class RankingCalculator

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.gamemanager.RankingCalculator
public class RankingCalculator extends Object
Computes the final ranking and global ranking point awards for a match.

Players are ranked by prestige points (descending), with food count as a tiebreaker (descending). Players with equal PP and food share the same rank. Each rank maps to a number of global ranking points that depends on the total player count; lower-ranking players in larger matches may receive a negative point award.

  • Method Details

    • calculateFinalRanking

      public Map<Integer, List<Player>> calculateFinalRanking(List<Player> players)
      Computes the final ranking for the given list of players.

      Players are sorted by prestige points descending, with food count as a tiebreaker. Players with identical PP and food share the same rank. The result is a TreeMap keyed by rank (1-based), where each entry holds the list of players at that rank.

      Parameters:
      players - the list of players to rank; may be null or empty
      Returns:
      an ordered map of rank → players; never null, empty if players is null or empty

    • calculateRankingPoints

      public Map<Player,Integer> calculateRankingPoints(List<Player> players, int numPlayers)
      Computes the global ranking points earned by each player in this match.

      The point award for each rank is determined by resolvePoints(int, int) and varies with the number of players. Players sharing a rank receive the same number of points.

      Parameters:
      players - the list of players to award points to
      numPlayers - the total number of players in the match (2–5)
      Returns:
      a map from each player to their global ranking point award; never null

    • resolvePoints

      private int resolvePoints(int rank, int numPlayers)
      Returns the global ranking points awarded to a player finishing at the given rank in a match with the given number of players.

      Point values by player count:

      • 2 players: 1st → +1, others → 0
      • 3 players: 1st → +1, 2nd → 0, 3rd → −1
      • 4 players: 1st → +2, 2nd → +1, 3rd → 0, 4th → −1
      • 5 players: 1st → +2, 2nd → +1, 3rd → 0, 4th → −1, 5th → −2
      Parameters:
      rank - the finishing rank (1-based)
      numPlayers - the total number of players in the match (2–5)
      Returns:
      the number of global ranking points for that rank and player count
